Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Regional point used for NASA's named Pacific-to-Indian throughflow among the Indonesian islands; it is not a channel centerline or length endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: NASA names the Pacific-to-Indian freshwater passage through narrow gaps of the Maritime Continent but gives no single current centerline or whole-system length. This is a multi-channel flow, so no length enters the ranking.
